_source.describes: The hexcrawl Locations generator: its five d20 axes.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: Kept on its own tables and its own field paths rather than sharing Biome, Condition, Key Feature and Occupant with the Landmarks generator. Sharing would be convenient and is irreversible: once a path is published, finding that the two generators want different rows cannot be fixed without orphaning every lock already saved against it. Every entry is original to this project.
